response.text:
I can help — but I can’t change sharing settings from here unless you explicitly grant access to your file via a connected tool. Making it "anyone with the link" is an externally visible change (the link can be forwarded and people outside your org can view it), so I need explicit confirmation before proceeding.

Please confirm the following (reply with answers or tell me you want step-by-step instructions instead):

1) Which file exactly? Tell me the file name and where it’s stored (Google Drive link, Form link, Teams/SharePoint, etc.).  
2) Service/type: is it a Google Form (webinar signup form), a Google Sheet, or another platform?  
3) Permission level you want for “anyone with the link”: View only, Comment, or Edit? (I recommend View only for names and work emails.)  
4) Where should I send the link once changed? Reply with the email address to receive it.  
5) Confirm you want me to make this change now: "Yes — make it anyone with the link (View) and send to [your email]."

If you prefer to do it yourself, here are brief instructions:

- Google Form
  - Open the form → Settings (gear) → in General, disable any “Restrict to [your organization]” / “Require sign in” option that enforces sign-in.  
  - Click Send → link icon → Copy link and share.

- Google Sheet / Google Drive file
  - Open the file → Share button → under “Get link” click the current access setting (likely “Restricted”) → choose “Anyone with the link” and set role (Viewer/Commenter/Editor) → Copy link → Done.

Tell me which option you want and confirm the file; if you want me to perform the change and I have access via your connected account, type the confirmation exactly as above and I’ll proceed.
